'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Battle of Geneina]]
****Thirteen new [[mass grave]]s are found in [[Geneina]] by the [[United Nations]], with an unspecified number of bodies. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/north-africa/2023/09/14/Credible-reports-of-at-least-13-mass-graves-in-Sudan-UN (Al Arabiya)]
***[[Battle of Nyala]]
****At least 40 people are killed in an airstrike on the El Malja market and several other neighborhoods in [[Nyala, Sudan|Nyala]] by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20230913-air-strikes-kill-dozens-in-nyala-as-sudan-violence-escalates-in-darfur (France 24)]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] announces that they have resumed drone operations and other counterterrorism missions in [[Niger]]. [https://apnews.com/article/niger-drones-counterterrorism-coup-military-62f51f379eb6b4cd3455b04772032547 (AP)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
***Four [[Indian Armed Forces|Indian troops]] and two rebels are killed in [[gunbattle]]s in [[Rajouri district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/13/indian-security-officers-rebels-killed-in-gun-battle-in-kashmir (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Rosatom]] chief Alexei Likhachev says [[Ukraine]] launched a [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] strike on [[Enerhodar]] near the [[Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant]] with all six drones being destroyed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-conducted-drone-attack-near-nuclear-plant-russias-rosatom-2023-09-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***Russia says that at least 24 people were injured in [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] missile strikes in [[Sevastopol]] and two boats were damaged in the attack. Ukraine claims to have destroyed the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] landing ship [[Russian landing ship Minsk|''Minsk'']], [[submarine]] {{ship|Russian submarine|B-237||2}} and a KC-701-class [[patrol boat]] of the [[Russian Navy]]'s [[Black Sea Fleet]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-sevastopol-925cf5d35b53ea061d1dc73dd0cf329f (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-missile-attack-sevastopol-crimea-russian-installed-governor-2023-09-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/defence-forces-of-ukrainian-sink-russian-boat-tuna-in-the-black-sea/ar-AA1gFAFU?ocid=msedgntp&cvid=59915786b362448387e599095164bd6d&ei=42 (MSN)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Five people are killed and 25 more injured during an explosion at a rally in the [[Gaza Strip]] marking the anniversary of [[Israel]]'s withdrawal from the Gaza Strip in 2005. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/13/deadly-explosion-hits-gaza-rally-marking-2005-israel-pullout (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Prime Minister of Poland]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] called on the [[European Union]] to extend an [[embargo]] on the [[import]] of [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] corn, wheat, sunflower and rapeseed. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-ukraine-grain-imports-ban-farmers-7737fbf97560fccf9768cc87b2949185 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Hanoi building fire]]
**At least 56 people are killed and 37 others are injured in a fire at a nine-story apartment building in [[Hanoi]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/13/many-killed-in-huge-fire-at-apartment-block-in-vietnams-hanoi (Al Jazeera)]
*Three people are killed and several others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a factory in [[Chieti]], [[Abruzzo]], [[Italy]]. A similar explosion at the factory in 2020 killed three workers. [https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2023/09/13/news/chieti_casalbordino_esplosione_in_fabbrica_due_morti-414335961/ (''La Repubblica'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 North Korea–Russia summit]]
**The [[North Korea]]–[[Russia]] summit is held at the [[Vostochny Cosmodrome]] in [[Amur Oblast]], Russia, lasting for four hours. [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] accepts an invitation from [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong Un]] to a reciprocal summit in North Korea. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-russia-kim-putin-missile-0d70f5190df1088ebe53e8ca19f8e9c9 (AP)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/vladimir-putin-accepts-north-korea-kim-jong-un-invitation-visit-3769461 (CNA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[8 January Brasília attacks|2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**The [[Supreme Federal Court|Brazilian Supreme Court]] holds the first trials of supporters of former [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] who took part in the January 8 attacks on government buildings at the [[Praça dos Três Poderes]] in [[Brasília]]. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/brazils-supreme-court-opens-trial-for-coup-attack/amp/ (La Prensa Latina)] [https://apnews.com/article/bolsonaro-rioters-government-offices-jan-8-trial-2fdb1bb1dc6b57184c73b077497e0d25 (AP)]
*[[Death of Sara Sharif]]
**Urfan Sharif, Benaish Batool and Faisal Malik fly from [[Sialkot International Airport|Sialkot]], [[Pakistan]], to [[Gatwick]], [[UK]], where police arrest them on suspicion of [[murder in English law|murder]]. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66804350 (BBC News)]  
*Escaped [[U.S.]] fugitive [[Danilo Cavalcante]] is captured in [[Pennsylvania]] by a team of tactical officers after a two week manhunt. [https://apnews.com/article/pennsylvania-prison-escape-danelo-cavalcante-brazil-057903609fa9a6815c19d9614988b349 (AP)]
